   (b) 'Search under the drawer in her workstation.',
   (c) 'Read the files on Michelle's memory card.',
   (d) 'Play the damaged recording on Michelle's memory card.',
   (e) the existing fourth prompt unchanged ('Hide what you found from the official ... as they leave.').
   Update the 1A comment line above it to match (1A.1 empty house -> 1A.2 hidden card -> read its files -> 1A.3 damaged recording -> 1A.4 patrol and gate marker). Do not change any other scene's prompts.

Raise that test's timeout to 45 * 60_000. Remove the now-unused spineJourney import. Do not change the @llm-canon test.
3. Update frontend/e2e/scene-walk.test.js: the test that asserts the second 1A prompt must expect the new second prompt 'Search under the drawer in her workstation.' (the test only checks the prompts it sends; do not weaken it).
4. New frontend/e2e/canon-journey.test.js (node:test, hermetic): assert (i) the 1A prompts are exactly the five above; (ii) promptFor('1A', 5) cycles back to the first prompt; (iii) the 1A prompts contain a prompt that includes the words 'Read' and 'memory card'; (iv) every scene id 1A..3C has at least one prompt; (v) spineJourney is not exported (import * as journey and assert !('spineJourney' in journey)).
